messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH error rate detected — control-plane -> auth-service (5xx). alerts: ctrl-auth-5xx-rate, latency-p95. Please acknowledge @ops-rotations :rotating_light:
alice.sre: acked. I'm pulling the auth and gateway dashboards now.
bob.platform: seeing a surge of 502/504s at the gateway layer, spike started ~3861234500 according to logs.
carol.infra: checking autoscale and recent deploys. No deploy in last 30m. infra metrics show increased connection timeouts to auth-db.
frank.runtime: logs from runtime show repeated upstream 502 from auth: "upstream read timeout" and kv-cache misses skyrocketing.
dave.prod: customer impact: some token exchanges failing -> downstream call chains erroring. CS reported ~5 users with errors. Prioritize fallback.
emily.cs: notified affected customers in the CS queue, collecting request IDs.
alice.sre: running quick grep on auth logs for 38612344*: `grep "ERROR" auth-service.log | tail -n 200 | less`
alice.sre: found spike of postgres connection errors: `FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections`
bob.platform: that looks like DB saturation. Any recent DB maintenance?
carol.infra: no maintenance. Patch-level autovacuum kicked earlier but shouldn't cause slot exhaustion. Could be a connection leak in new client path.
frank.runtime: suggestion: enable auth-service circuit-breaker -> route auth reads to warm standby or reduce max-conns per instance.
ops-rotations: assigning pager to alice.sre for live mitigation. handoff note: priority P1, impact partial control-plane failure, potential customer-visible errors.
alice.sre: starting mitigation: 1) temp scale auth-service up x2, 2) set connection pool limit lower at proxy, 3) enable fallback token cache. Executing now.
carol.infra: scaling auth-service replicas: `kubectl scale deployment/auth-service --replicas=8 -n prod` -> rolling pods appearing.
bob.platform: patching gateway routing: add fallback route to auth-read-only at path /oauth/verify -> `gatewayctl route add --service auth-readonly --percent 30` (will shift 30% reads)
frank.runtime: enabling in-memory token cache fallback (TTL 60s) in runtime config: ```yaml
runtime:
  token_cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_s: 60
    max_items: 50000
```
dave.prod: please capture a short customer-facing summary for the postmortem when stable.
emily.cs: collecting all affected customer cases and ETA. Will update Slack thread when we have batch.
alice.sre: DB connection errors reduced after scale and route change — error rate falling from 13% -> 2% over last 3m.
incident-bot: Alert resolved: ctrl-auth-5xx-rate reverted to normal thresholds. Alarm will auto-close in 5m if stable.
carol.infra: follow-up: need to investigate root cause of connection slot exhaustion — likely leak in client retry path that caused storm. Opening ticket: infra-3872.
bob.platform: will revert gateway fallback after further verification. Plan: gradual rollback of the 30% split back to 0% over 20m.
frank.runtime: posting the quick commands I ran for trace gathering: ```bash
# tail errors for pod
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/auth-service -c app --since=15m | grep "FATAL" | head -n 50
# check DB slots
psql -h db-primary -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state!='idle';"
```
ops-rotations: handoff to night oncall (bob.platform) at 3861234700 with summary: "auth DB slot exhaustion caused gateway 5xx cascade; mitigations applied: auth scaled, gateway routing fallback, token cache enabled. Monitor DB connections, investigate client retries."
alice.sre: leaving detailed notes in incident runbook and creating a postmortem draft. I'll assign owners for DB investigation and runtime client fix.
emily.cs: CS notified customers A and C with short summary and ETA to follow.
dave.prod: thanks all. We'll sync in 1h retro. If anyone sees regression reopen ping here. :thumbsup:
